subject: Model-fit workshop recap & proposed evals — Medify.ai
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@medify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Model-fit workshop recap & proposed evals — Medify.ai

Hi Ellen — thanks again for the hour today. Short recap and concrete next steps so we all have alignment.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce incorrect guidance in patient triage flows and improve citation/grounding for clinical recommendations.
- Target SLOs: <200ms median latency for UI flows, hallucination rate <5% on clinical Qs, grounding precision@1 >= 85%.
- Data availability: you can share ~100 representative conversational snippets and the internal FAQ zip (you mentioned export to S3).

Redwood proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Early probe: run sample snippets through 3 model+retrieval variants to get coarse lift estimates (accuracy, grounding precision, token cost).
   - Candidate models: redwood-7b-v2-qa (quantized), redwood-13b-std (safety-tuned), open-13b-8q (baseline).
2) Retrieval variants: dense embeddings (Redwood-embed-rail) with 768-d vectors vs BM25 prefilter + embeddings. Compare top-k retrieval (k=3,5,10) and chunking strategies (250/token overlapping 50).
3) Reranker decision: run a small cross-encoder pairwise reranker (ce-rank-small) vs a lightweight learned scorer; measure precision@1 and latency impact.
4) Grounding metrics and probes: factuality probes, source attribution rate, and the "contradiction probe" set in the eval kit.

Attachments: eval-matrix-template.csv (starter), reranker-options-brief.pdf. I've also attached the 100-sample snippets you mentioned as medify_sample_snippets_100.jsonl — please confirm.

Immediate asks for Medify.ai:
- Share the 100-snippet export (or confirm the S3 path).
- Confirm whether PII redaction is required before we ingest samples.
- Any constraints on embedding models (e.g., you must use a private embedding model)?

Next operational steps (proposed):
- Today: you confirm sample availability and redaction constraints.
- Wed (12/09): Redwood runs probe batch and shares a short bench report (latency, token cost, grounding precision@1).
- Follow-up call: Thurs (12/10) to review probe results and pick the pilot variant.

If the timeline works I’ll book the bench run slot and loop in our eval engineer (Aditya) for setup.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@medify.ai>

Date: 2026-12-05T11:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Model-fit workshop recap & proposed evals — Medify.ai

Thanks Vanessa — this is great, clear plan. A few clarifications before we hand over the sample: 

- I'll upload the 100 snippets to the S3 path you gave in the call by EOD tomorrow. They include PII but we can provide a redacted version if you prefer (we'd like you to run both raw and redacted if possible).
- For embedding constraints: our security team prefers managed embeddings inside our VPC, but we can allow Redwood-hosted embeddings for the probe stage if we keep the probe data ephemeral.
- Grounding precision@1 target looks right; latency is more flexible for the probe.

One ask from procurement: can you estimate the cost of the three probe variants ahead of the run? We want a ballpark to pre-approve the spend.

I'll attach the S3 upload link once the files are up.

— Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Product, Medify.ai
ellen.park@medify.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@medify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, procurement@medify.ai
Date: 2026-12-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Model-fit workshop recap & proposed evals — Medify.ai

Great — thanks Ellen. Quick cost/capacity notes for procurement (high-level estimates for the probe run on 100 snippets):
- Variant A (redwood-7b-v2-qa + dense embeddings): ~ $60–$85 total (quantized tokens + embed calls).
- Variant B (redwood-13b-std + dense embeddings, cross-encoder reranker): ~ $180–$240 (reranker CPU/GPU costs add up).
- Variant C (open-13b-8q baseline + BM25 prefilter): ~ $45–$70.

These are rough — final invoiceable numbers depend on per-token counts in the snippets and any night/weekend run discounts we can apply. I'll record exact probe costs in the bench report.

Notes on evaluation artifacts I'm preparing and links:
- Eval matrix (attached) tracks: grounding precision@1, source attr. rate, hallucination rate (manual adjudication sample), latency median/95th, token cost.
- Prompt sets: I'll seed the probe with a 12-prompt suite (clarifying Qs, long-context, edge-case clinical Qs). Link to prompts + runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-example-eval-kit
- Reranker brief: quick decision tree in reranker-options-brief.pdf (attached) — we recommend cross-encoder for high-precision workflows but a learned lightweight scorer for production latency-sensitive flows.

Question re: acceptance criteria for pilot: will you accept a pilot where grounding precision@1 is 80% (with plan to push to 85% in model tuning), or is 85% required before pilot launch? That will change our recommended default variant.

I'll wait for the S3 link and confirmation on redaction. We can proceed with the probe Wed as planned once files are in.

Best,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Model-fit workshop recap & proposed evals — Medify.ai

Quick internal + FYI to Medify: I ran the probe schedule with Aditya — proposed timeline below, plus SRE/ops checklist.

Proposed timeline:
- 12/08 AM: Redwood ingest (we pull S3, verify format, run quick dedupe).
- 12/08 PM: Probe run (three variants, single pass).
- 12/09 AM: Bench report and cost breakdown to Medify (Vanessa to share).
- 12/10 10:00am PT: Review call and variant decision.

SRE/ops checklist (for Medify and Redwood coordination):
- S3 access (read-only) + temp credentials window (we do ephemeral copy).
- Confirm PII redaction preference (raw + redacted recommended).
- Confirm region for probe execution (we recommend us-west-2 to minimize latency).

Deliverables after probe: bench-report.pdf, annotated sample outputs (20 edge cases with adjudication notes), updated eval-matrix.csv with measured metrics.

I'll loop in Solutions Engineering for the follow-up call once the bench report is ready. Vanessa — I'll let you own scheduling with Ellen.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
